fusions.name: Bitter Draw
fusions.desc: Throws a fine mesh that deals 9 damage to the first enemy it meets. It needs one of your afflictions on the target and uses it up, and you heal for 25% of the damage dealt.

fusions.name: Shaken Dregs
fusions.desc: Shakes the strained dregs out of the mesh across a cone 3 tiles long, dealing 4 damage to everything caught in it, with a 50% chance per hit to leave it [Poisoned] for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Strain the Blood
fusions.desc: Draws a mesh through your blood that strains up to 3 poison conditions out of you and restores 10 health.

fusions.name: Gift Returned
fusions.desc: Each condition laid on you has a 20% chance to be caught in the mesh and sent back to whoever inflicted it instead.
